title: POLY-GONE - Puzzle game involving polygons
author: heic92
selftext:
Hi everyone!

I would love to get some feedback on the concept of my puzzle game called POLY-GONE that is free to play with no login required. There are 2 modes which is Drop (similar to Tetris) and Swipe (similar to Tsum Tsum) with 3 rules:

1. Match 3 of the same shape  
2. Match 3 of the same color  
3. Match 3 of the same pattern

It is developed using Claude with sound effects still being a bit “stock”, would welcome suggestions for platform or tools that are good with audio assets! 

This game was a thought that I’ve had for awhile but wasn’t able to build it with Emergent or Lovable back then, since then I’ve gotten a tad bit more experience vibe coding.

[Link to game here!](https://www.poly-gone.com)
